$comment: Online catalog of M365 Copilot models, downloaded by the VS Code extension on start and every 12 h (setting m365copilot.models.updateFromCatalog). Add an entry to offer a new model to every user without a release; set "hidden": true to retire one. 'tone' is the BizChat tone the web app sends (the browser extension and userscript also detect them automatically). 'name' is shown after 'M365 Copilot · '.

detail.en: GPT 5.6 (fast answers) — M365 Copilot’s preferred model since July 2026.
